title: Harness → SKOS concept (glossary)
description: How scripts/glossary-export.ts writes a harness (a layer declaration) as a skos:Concept in that layer's glossary, beside the roles and the node kinds. Work item folio-assistant-dkqd (2026-11-04): a reader met "C@T Harness", "Folio Assistant" and "Bootstrap" with nothing defining them. The label is the declaration's title (else its name), the definition its summary (else its description). The concept's IRI is the declaration's iriBase, the address the harness already has, never a second name. Its sibling for node kinds is glossary-kind-concept.

target.comment: The ledger key, `harness/<name>`: a code, unique in the scheme.
Prepared in code: the declaration's alsoWritten spellings and its name, minus the title, deduplicated and sorted.
vocabulary-authority: skos:prefLabel is the fact, dcterms:title its derived copy (bean sl9u).
